title: RevertRaidChanges-Extra-VaultsOminousBottleRemove
description: Removed the Ominous Bottle from the Vault LootTable.
body:
## Description
This DataPack is an extension of [RevertRaidChanges-Normal](https://modrinth.com/datapack/revertraidchanges-normal) and [RevertRaidChanges-Pro](https://modrinth.com/datapack/revertraidchanges-pro). 

It removes the OminousBottle from the Vault LootTable without changing the appearance probability of other items.
